a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both with nothing. The reserve holds only 4, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I intend to take 4 this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that and won't take anything more, so you can reach 4. If you want to propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so you can take 4 as soon as the reserve allows.
